race.comment: GOLDEN WARRIOR (3) finished out of the money two starts back then was beaten tenth in a 1400m contest at Canberra eight days ago. Perfectly placed and is sure to go close. KULINA (11) was out of the money when resuming from a spell last start over 1200m at Ballarat Synthetic, beaten 5.5 lengths after being prominent at the bend. Finds a suitable assignment and can get the job done. ROULLOTTIE (9) faded right out of it last time over 1200m at Canberra after showing good early speed and leading for much of the way, eventually finishing sixth. Will give a sight. TALUK (5) was beaten 4 lengths into sixth over 1000m at Canberra eight days ago. Well placed and can take a hand in the finish this time.
